title: Remove an app from Login Items in System Settings
summary: Stop an app from opening automatically when you log in by removing it from the Login Items list in System Settings. The app itself stays installed.

mac app opens at startup how to stop

как отключить автозапуск программы на маке
приложение само открывается при входе в mac

steps.explain: Open System Settings, go to General, then Login Items & Extensions. The Open at Login list shows the apps that start when you log in.
steps.gui: Apple menu > System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions > Open at Login

steps.explain: Select the app you want to stop from opening at login. Its name is in the Open at Login list.
steps.gui: Click the app's name in the Open at Login list

steps.explain: Remove the app from the list. The app is not uninstalled and will not start at login anymore.
steps.gui: Click the minus (-) button under the Open at Login list
steps.expect: The app disappears from the Open at Login list.

rollback.explain: To make the app open at login again, add it back to the same list.
rollback.gui: System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions > Open at Login > click the plus (+) button and choose the app

warnings: Removing a login item only stops the app from starting automatically. It does not uninstall the app or delete its data.
Some apps add their own login item and may add it back when they update or change settings; check the list again after using the app.
Login Items shows apps for the current user only. Items for other users are not listed here.
